# Authored ornaments

Black penwork ivy corners, dividers, fillers, a manuscript frame, a headpiece and a tailpiece, painted gold lozenge and cinquefoil dividers, and a choirbook with ivy, all made by adrian729 as original ornaments in the manner of medieval book decoration.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `authored-ornaments`, authored, 16 assets, version 1.0.0.

## Use one asset

Pin the exact version (never `@latest`). For `authored-ornaments/acanthus-tailpiece`:

```html
<img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ranx729/ducktape-assets-authored-ornaments@1.0.0/webp/acanthus-tailpiece-512.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">
```

Package `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-authored-ornaments`; every file, width and format is listed in its `manifest.json`. Masters live in git under `assets/<id>/` and in `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-authored-ornaments-masters`; never put a master on a page.
